channel.title: ABDALLAH ABAS Blog
channel.description: Practical articles on online earning, SEO and web building

item.title: The Road to AdSense (3): The Essential Pages — from About to Privacy Policy
item.description: Part three of the Road to AdSense series: the four pages reviewers check before your articles — About, Contact, Privacy Policy, and Terms — exactly what to write on each, where to place them, and the mistakes that get sites rejected over them.

item.title: The Road to AdSense (4): Choosing a Niche — Between Your Passion and What Advertisers Pay For
item.description: Part four of the Road to AdSense series: a practical frame of three tests for choosing the right niche — real experience, search demand, advertiser interest — with analysis of real decision examples and a decision table that stops bad starts.

item.title: The Road to AdSense (5): Domain and Hosting — What Actually Matters to Google and AdSense
item.description: Part five of the Road to AdSense series: choosing a domain name you will not regret, when a subdomain suffices and when you need your own, real hosting criteria beyond the speed, HTTPS, and common DNS mistakes — practical decisions, not ad comparisons.

item.title: The Road to AdSense (6): A Navigation Structure Helping Crawlers and Visitors Alike
item.description: Part six of the Road to AdSense series: the three-clicks rule, building categories without overlap, what enters the main menu versus the footer, internal links inside articles, and search and archive pages — a navigation map lifting review and ranking together.

item.title: Earning Sources (1): The Full Map of Blog Income — Where the Money Actually Comes From
item.description: Part one of the earning sources series: a complete map of blog income methods from ads to affiliate to services and products, with criteria for choosing what fits your stage and common diversification mistakes.

item.title: Improving LCP Step by Step: The Fastest Road to Lifting Your Real Speed Measurements
item.description: Part one of the performance series: a practical guide to improving the LCP metric — from diagnosing your responsible element to image, font and server fixes ordered by real impact, with free measurement tools.

item.title: SEO Foundations (3): Keyword Research — A Complete Method for New Sites
item.description: Part three of the SEO foundations series: a full practical keyword research method using free tools only — from idea generation to filtering to building a monthly article list — with a ready checklist.

item.title: SEO Foundations (1): How Search Engines Work — Crawling, Indexing and Ranking in Plain Language
item.description: Part one of the SEO foundations series: a simple explanation of the search engine's three stages from crawling to indexing to ranking, and why understanding them matters to every site owner wanting Google traffic.

item.title: SEO Foundations (2): Search Intent — The Key Deciding Which Page You Write and How
item.description: Part two of the SEO foundations series: what search intent is and its four types, how to read intent from Google's results themselves, and how to align your article's structure with what the searcher actually wants.

item.title: Invalid Traffic in AdSense: How It Reaches Your Account and How to Protect It in Time
item.description: A practical explanation of invalid traffic and suspicious ad clicks: their real sources, early signals in your reports, what to do when an AdSense warning arrives, and how to build preventive protection — without fear or recklessness.

item.title: AdSense Policies in Depth (1): The Complete Policy Map — What's Allowed and What Isn't, Before It Surprises You
item.description: Part one of the AdSense policies series: a complete map of policy categories from original content to click behavior, with simple explanations, common unintentional violations, and how to track updates without anxiety.

item.title: The Road to AdSense (1): Foundations You Build Before Your First Post
item.description: Part one of The Road to AdSense series: the seven decisions to make before writing a single post — niche, domain, page structure, navigation, performance, indexing, and legal pages — with a final pre-launch checklist.

item.title: The Road to AdSense (2): Your First 30 Posts — a No-Filler, No-Duplicate Plan
item.description: Part two of The Road to AdSense series: a practical plan for your first thirty posts — topic clusters, search-intent distribution, a realistic publishing schedule, and an internal-linking plan from day one — plus the list of what you must never write at this stage.

item.title: The Road to AdSense (10): The Review Journey — What Happens to Your Application After You Press Submit
item.description: Part ten of the Road to AdSense series: your application's stages from automated checks to the decision, normal waiting times, what to do while waiting, and how to read the reply either way — no guessing.

item.title: The Road to AdSense (8): Mobile-First Design, Because Google and Your Readers Hold Phones
item.description: Part eight of the Road to AdSense series: why the reviewer opens your site from a phone, and how to build a mobile experience that lifts approval, ranking and earnings together — with tested practical steps.

item.title: The AdSense Approval Checklist: 14 Points to Review Before You Hit Submit
item.description: Before you submit your AdSense application, review this checklist in order: original content, legal pages, navigation, indexing, speed, and your identity as a publisher — so you enter review from the strongest possible position.

item.title: Core Web Vitals Explained: The Three Metrics That Tell You How Fast Your Site Really Is
item.description: A practical guide to the three Core Web Vitals: LCP, INP and CLS — what each one measures, how to check yours for free, and real fixes that improve your site speed and visitor experience.

item.title: Search Console for Beginners: Your First 8 Steps After Adding a Site
item.description: A practical guide to first Search Console steps: verifying ownership, submitting your sitemap, checking indexing, reading the important reports, and tracking page performance — tested steps on a real site.

item.title: A Monthly Content Plan: How to Decide What to Write Before You Sit Down
item.description: A practical method for building a monthly content plan: choosing topics from keywords, mixing content types, scheduling publishing, and measuring results at month's end — so you never write in a panic again.

item.title: Free Tools for Content Creators: A Complete Work Kit With Zero Subscriptions
item.description: A practical review of free tools covering the full content journey: writing, images, SEO, performance measurement, and organization — tools I actually use, with each tool's free limits stated honestly.
